run_domain_generalization_training: run domain generalization training with ERM algorithm on RotatedMNIST dataset with automatic learning rate scheduling
run_domain_adaptation_training: run unsupervised domain adaptation training using UDA splits and unlabeled test environment samples
run_two_stage_training: run two-stage training pipeline that first trains with holdout splits then retrains with full data
run_training_with_custom_hparams: run training with custom JSON-serialized hyperparameters and configurable checkpoint frequency
run_training_with_model_checkpoints: run training with periodic model checkpoint saving and final model persistence to output directory
